description: This Java class implements the default configuration for health checks in the Gateway service, providing methods to create instances from configuration data and access configuration parameters.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Implementation of the health check configuration for the Gateway service, defining parameters like service timeout, basic health check settings, and cluster roles.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a DefaultHealthCheckConfig instance from a Config object, using a fallback mechanism and default sub-configurations.

methods.name: getServiceTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured service timeout duration.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the health check is enabled based on the basic health check configuration.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration between health checks.
